answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks via Proof of Space-Time, where a sequential hashing kernel forces each identity to seal gigabytes of unique data to disk and answer random Merkle audits each epoch. Because recomputing proofs on the fly is too slow, attackers incur real storage and energy costs per clone, anchoring the agent reef in ferrous hardware rather than cheap scripts. However, cloud providers enjoy bulk disk discounts, while stateless edge agents are excluded.
